name: SEATREPLICA-read-binding
note: the kept read on the request's database - the primary's queue again (LEAN-READS: re-aimed by content at the code the slice moved)

name: SEATREPLICA-mark-unkept
note: the bookmark a kept read ended at thrown away - a replica behind it may answer

name: SEATREPLICA-write-unmarked
note: a write here not marked - the next read any instance's, which may not have it

name: SEATREPLICA-primary-skipped
note: the read after a write here from the old bookmark, not the primary

name: SEATREPLICA-mark-uncleared
note: a write read back never done with - every read after it the primary's

name: SEATREPLICA-every-report-forgets
note: a report the table already held lets the kept rows go

name: SEATREPLICA-no-report-forgets
note: a new report written here never lets them go

name: SEATREPLICA-failed-mark-kept
note: a bookmark whose read failed kept for the next

name: SEATREPLICA-newer-mark-dropped
note: an older read's failure lets a newer read's bookmark go

name: SEATREPLICA-open-unguarded
old: try { session = replicaDb(opener, from); } catch { /* a bookmark D1 refuses: the request's database */ }
note: a session D1 refuses to open throws past the read

name: SEATREPLICA-uncounted
old: const opener = typeof db?.withSession === 'function' ? db : root;
note: the session opened on the binding, past the request's count
